gates.title: Wings and Ascension
gates.blurb: Two story quests around the lake. Don't delay them.

items.t: Complete "The Being Beneath the Lake" (unlocks wings) and "Spread Your Wings". Its Ascension step is Asahr's quest "The One Who Perceives" at Dream Crossroads; finishing it completes that step and gives your first wings.Story quests in Ishalgen · Witch's Cabin · Elvida (after "Isolated Lake")

gates.title: Enhancement unlocks
gates.blurb: Save your stones; only the belt and amulet are always worth it.

items.t: Save your Enhance Stones in the Cube. Enhancei the belt and Revelation amulet once you have them; other gear only if a boss or Sealed Dungeon actually stops you, weapon first. The first real supply is the Lv 10 Sealed Dungeons (1,250 each). Belt enhance scrolls come only from Strongholds (2 each); both are in Dungeons & Strongholds.
items.note: The 5 stones from the Lv 7 quest were likely spent in Pelleir's tutorial, usually on your starting weapon (look for a +1). Extract that weapon once it's replaced to get them back.

gates.title: Altgard opens
gates.blurb: Extraction and pets unlock. Sealed Dungeons and Strongholds open; tick them in Dungeons & Strongholds.

items.t: Extracti gear you've replaced: open the Cube, click the old piece, choose Extract and confirm. Only gear in your Cube can be extracted, not what you're wearing, so the option appears once a drop replaces something.
Complete "Gathering Essentials" to unlock pets, then set the pet loot filteri.Story quest after "Survival Supplies" · Safe Haven · VeKauf
items.note: Pet choice: take Armadon or Tog. All three ride and give the same bonus, but Fossa can be collected later from Fossa soul drops around Lv 24.

items.t: Use the Wisdom Stones from Sealed Dungeons and quests. Each becomes 1 Skill Pointi only when you use it from your Cube.
Claim Daeva Pass free-track rewards as you earn them.

items.sub: Sealed Dungeons

gates.title: Daevanion board
gates.blurb: First Daevanion board (Nezekan) opens at Lv 12; first regional quest.

items.t: Complete "Urgent Pursuit" to unlock the Daevanion boardi. Use every Daevanion Crystals from the Cube. Nodes are in the Daevanion board card at the top. Two clusters, from your board: above the centre, Heart Gore with Exploit Weakness 1 branching off its path (11 for both); below the centre, Ambush (7) and Quick Slice (6) share their first two nodes (11 for both), and Exploit Weakness 2 sits 5 past Quick Slice. All five come to 27. Where a node has two routes, take the one with Critical Hit and Attack over HP and Critical Hit resist.Story quest after "Veiled Truth" · Quai Campsite · Ulgorn
items.note: Same quest unlocks the Shugo Festival. Leave the festival alone.

Noble Belt: the main story hands it to you around Lv 13 (it can't be missed). Enhance it +1 each time you get a Noble Belt Enhance Scroll (2 per Stronghold, see Dungeons & Strongholds). Each +1 also costs Enhance Stones and Kina; success is 100%.

items.note: Belt and amulet to +10 (Rare) cost about 232,000 Kina and 9,280 Enhance Stones each. Later, Substance Morph moves one up a tier and resets it to +0; that's a Lv 45 Kina sink.

items.t: Complete "The One Who Hears the Voice" to unlock Stigmasi and the Pantheon.Ascension quest from Asahr. Opens once your Ascension Gauge is at 100% and the story reaches "Daeva in a Dream" (Lv 22). Journal (J) → Ascension tab → Teleport (bottom right) takes you to Asahr.
Equip Triniel's Dagger. Long-term target is skill level 10. Check first: Metabot puts Illusive Clone in slot 1 and Triniel's Dagger last. If Illusive Clone is equippable at 22, use it here instead.

gates.title: Supply Requests
gates.blurb: Hand in spare items for Abyss Points.

items.t: Hand in spares to Supply Requestsi. Only items you already have and don't need; don't buy for it while leveling. Abyss Points matter mostly at 45.

gates.title: Level cap
gates.blurb: Progression shifts from level to gear score.

items.t: Finish the remaining Hero and Ascension quests: "The One Who Witnesses the Nightmare" (recommended 45) and "The One Who Swears the Oath" (recommended 49, so expect it to need gear), both from Asahr.Journal (J) → Ascension tab → Teleport (bottom right) takes you to Asahr.
Spend your banked Shugo Festival keys.
Azphel Daevanion boardi opens. Stat nodes only, paid with Azphel points from Abyss, arena and battlefield shops, not Daevanion Crystals.
Ascension Trial timing. Days before reset: reach item level 1,500 first. Reset close: run it at 1,000 rather than waste the week.
Abyss Points on Potential Stones, Stigma Shards and Daevanion resources, not a shop gear set.
Start Conquest (Krao Cave tier, gear scorei 700). Weapon first, then your weakest slots.
